name: setup-agentic-workflow
description: Set up a repository so coding agents work safely in it — AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md entry points, code map, boundaries and human-review paths, REVIEW.md and a PR template when the team uses AI review, an optional ROADMAP.md from your milestones, one shared check command, living docs/HANDOFF.yaml, optional CI — as four skills (orchestrator, agent-entrypoints, quality-gate, handoff) plus hooks that re-inject the handoff after compaction and keep it fresh. For Claude Code and Codex, single repos and monorepos. Not for implementing product features. Code review lives in the separate dual-review plugin.
